description: This file contains the implementation of a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing Employee Immigration Records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching immigration records, with integration to entities, search filters, and ORM functionalities.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
classes.description: A DAO class responsible for CRUD operations and search functionalities related to Employee Immigration Records in the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity, assigning a new recordId if necessary, with validation.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeImmigrationRecord based on employee number and record ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeImmigrationIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing immigration record IDs for a given employee number within a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Deletes specified immigration records for an employee based on record IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all immigration records associated with a specific employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Performs a search and returns immigration records matching filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsPaginator
methods.description: Prepares a paginated query for immigration records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of immigration records matching the search filter parameters.
